record.what_it_does: HubSpot is a cloud CRM and marketing/sales/service platform whose API lets developers read and write contacts, companies, deals, tickets, and other CRM/marketing data on behalf of a HubSpot account.
record.auth_notes: OAuth is required for apps distributed to multiple accounts (private distribution up to 10 allowlisted accounts, or public Marketplace distribution). A static 'private app' Bearer access token is available for single-account use and is 'implemented on top of OAuth.' A separate legacy Developer API key (hapikey) authenticates some app-management endpoints, and short-lived OAuth2 client-credentials tokens are used for the webhooks journal API.
record.access_notes: Any developer can sign up for a free HubSpot account/developer account and immediately create a private app to get a working Bearer access token, or build an OAuth app usable in up to 10 allowlisted accounts without vendor review. Listing an OAuth app publicly on the HubSpot Marketplace (needed to distribute broadly to third-party accounts) requires an Ecosystem Quality team review with requirements like 3 active unique installs and an initial review within 10 business days.
record.main_blocker: Marketplace app review required to distribute OAuth access broadly beyond 10 allowlisted accounts
